posts.subject: TTT_Terminal Massive bug
posts.bodyHtml:
Hello Dear Dream Community,


Today I have came across a massive bug which you can make on the TTT terminal as demonstrated you can get on the roof which you can see the whole map from and tested with @wickedy you can actually shoot through the roof but people can't shoot you back, this map should get fixed or removed totally as people will abuse this a lot.


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hpGOtCdYx4Y&feature=youtu.be
I like @wickedy 's comment: "I need to talk with mike and oxy if they think it's intended to go there." 😏 ofc it's intended to shoot through a 1-sided map-glitch 😏 #keinZaun

Zitat von Krimz
